faq.q: What is the origin of Aarifah?
faq.a: Aarifah is associated with Arabic. Variant romanization of aarifa.
Yes — the underlying form عارفة is Arabic.
Aarifah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Aarifah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. root ع ر ف occurs in the Qur'an; عارفة is a normal Arabic feminine form

faq.q: What are the variants of Aarifah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Aarifah, aarifah, arifah. Script forms are عارفة, عارفه, عارفہ, आरिफ़ा.

faq.q: Is Aarifah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
